title: Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Schema Matching
abstract: arXiv:2501.08686v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Traditional similarity-based schema matching methods fail to resolve semantic ambiguities and conflicts in complex, domain-specific mappings due to a lack of commonsense and domain-specific knowledge. In parallel, large language models (LLMs) without sufficient background knowledge tend to hallucinate, further complicating schema matching. To overcome these limitations, we introduce KG-RAG4SM, a Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Schema Matching. This method integrates novel retrieval mechanisms, including LLM-based, vector-based, graph traversal-based, and hybrid techniques with advanced reranking schemes to extract the most relevant subgraphs from large external KGs. Our approach achieves superior results without requiring re-training, as evidenced by improvements of 39.79% in precision and 30.56% in F1 score over LLM-based state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods (e.g., Jellyfish-8B) on the MIMIC dataset, and en

translated_title: 基于知识图谱的检索增强生成模式匹配方法
translated_abstract: 传统的基于相似度的模式匹配方法由于缺乏常识和领域特定知识，无法解决复杂的、特定领域映射中的语义歧义和冲突。与此同时，缺乏足够背景知识的大语言模型（LLM）容易产生幻觉，进一步增加了模式匹配的难度。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了KG-RAG4SM，一种基于知识图谱的模式匹配检索增强生成方法。该方法集成了新颖的检索机制，包括基于LLM的、基于向量的、基于图遍历的以及混合技术，并结合先进的重排序方案，从大型外部知识图谱中提取最相关的子图。我们的方法无需重新训练即可取得优越的结果，在MIMIC数据集上，相比基于LLM的最先进（SOTA）方法（如Jellyfish-8B），精确率提升了39.79%，F1分数提升了30.56%。
tldr: 提出KG-RAG4SM方法，通过集成多种新颖检索机制与重排序技术从外部知识图谱中提取相关子图，无需重新训练即在模式匹配任务上显著超越现有基于LLM的最先进方法。
en_tdlr: KG-RAG4SM, a Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation method for schema matching, integrates novel retrieval mechanisms with advanced reranking to extract relevant subgraphs from external KGs, achieving substantial improvements over LLM-based SOTA methods without re-training.
